name: favicon-search
title: Favicon Search
description: A search field with a keyboard-driven result list that shows an icon, title and description per row.

props.name: results
props.description: Results to list: { id, title, url, description?, favicon? }. Filter them yourself as the query changes.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new query on every keystroke.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a result is picked with click or Enter.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows instead of results.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Text shown when a query has no results.

props.name: groupLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the results list.

props.name: showShortcut
props.description: Shows a shortcut hint and focuses the field on Cmd/Ctrl + hotkey.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Key used with Cmd/Ctrl to focus the field.

props.name: maxResults
props.description: Shows at most this many results.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the panel and rows take to animate.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
